chunks: And he, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Indeed, blessing comes more swiftly to the house from which good is given than a blade passes into the hump of a camel, or a flood reaches its end."

key_terms.الشَّفْرَةِ: the blade, used here for speed and penetration in comparison
key_terms.الْبَرَكَةَ: divine blessing and increase bestowed by Allah
key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: the household or home that is the locus of blessing
key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفُ: recognized good, kindness, and beneficent conduct
key_terms.سَنَامِ: the hump, specifically the hump of a camel
key_terms.يُمْتَارُ: that from which provision or benefit is drawn

ai.seo_question: How quickly does barakah come to a house that gives goodness to others?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that divine blessing quickly comes to a household from which acts of kindness and goodness are extended to others. It emphasizes the spiritual benefit and rapid return of generosity and beneficence in a vivid and forceful image.
